findings.text: Expected field values come from the same sidecar as dispatch_field, so corrupted values pass the assertion and presence checks.
The required ruff check and format-check results are absent from the gate record.
Both sides derive picker selection from the same accessor; an incorrect shared value passes.
The AST scan catches only variables named pointer and misses direct reads under aliases.
